pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: The maison behind Vérane — how each piece of jewellery and every fragrance is made in small numbers, by the hands that designed it.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Vérane is a small maison of fine jewellery and fragrance. We work in gold, platinum and hand-selected stones, and in scent composed a few litres at a time — and we make in numbered runs, in our own atelier, by the people whose hands are on the work.

Nothing here is bought in and re-badged. We can tell you where every stone came from, who set it, and how to keep a piece bright for a lifetime. That is the whole idea: cut and composed in small numbers, made to be kept.

pages.name: Contact
pages.seoDescription: Get in touch with Vérane — questions, orders and anything else you need.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-8

children: Our atelier and salon are open by appointment. Tell us what you are looking for — a single piece, a bespoke commission, or a fragrance to be layered to your own — and we will find a time.
